description: November 10 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 10 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 10 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 10th of November reduces to 1, giving Scorpio's seventeenth degree a pioneering edge. Neptune's sub-rulership of the second decan contributes vision and inspiration. Together, they are often read as an independent dreamer with the drive to act on what they imagine, someone who would rather start something original than wait for permission or consensus.

On November 10 the Sun usually sits at about 17° Scorpio, in the second decan, where Neptune is the sub-ruler alongside Pluto. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: November 10 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 10 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on November 10: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 10 is the 314th day of the year (315th in a leap year). By November 23, 13 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 10, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 10 include Friedrich Schiller (1759), Mikhail Kalashnikov (1919) and Ennio Morricone (1928).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 10?
faq.answer: November 10 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 10 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 10?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 10 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 10?
faq.answer: November 10 is also the birthday of Friedrich Schiller (1759), Mikhail Kalashnikov (1919) and Ennio Morricone (1928). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
